name: Cozy Time
source:
Autumn has finally come and with it an old friend. 

You haven't seen them in a while, but not much has changed. They still love Autumn showers and pumpkin spice foods. Time to catch up on how life's been and treat each other with a calm day (or maybe more?)

[From [url=https://gewi-studios.itch.io/cozy-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
秋天终于来了，随之而来的是一位老朋友。

你已经有一段时间没见到他们了，但并没有太大变化。他们仍然喜欢秋天的阵雨和南瓜香料食物。是时候回顾一下生活，并以平静的一天（或者也许更多？）对待彼此。

[来自[url=https://gewi-studios.itch.io/cozy-time]Itch.io[/url]]
